page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head at the top and the page number at the upper right. No marginal notes. A catchword and gathering signature sit below the last line. Edge and show-through marks on both sides are left out.

main_text.p: totus exercitus certatim conferret opera, non interdiu, non noctu laborem intermittendo, tandem territi aggressi sunt diversa portus parte, qua peninsula procurrit in medium pelagus, fodiendo aperire os aliud, quo nullus agger procedere poterat propter maris altitudinem, & vim ventorum saevientem. Fodiebant autem populariter unà cum mulieribus & pueris, intus incipientes, & occulte versantes in opere: simulque triremes ac quinqueremes aedificabant è materia vetere, summa cum alacritate ac audacia. Et adeo celabant omnia, ut ne captivi quidem possent Scipioni quicquam manifeste dicere, nisi strepitum in portubus esse die noctuque continuum, caeterum, in quem usum, sc nescire: donec apparatis iam rebus omnibus Carthaginien-ses aperuerunt os portus circa diluculum, & eruperunt quinquaginta triremibus: cercurus vero, myoparonibus & aliis minoribus navigiis multis, ad terrorem ornati egregie. Romanos & novum os repente apertum, & classus inde erumpens terruit, ut Carthaginienses, si continuo classem aggressi fuissent, neglectam absentibus & ad oppugnationem versis tum sociis navalibus, tum remigibus, facile totam potuerint in suam potestatem redigere. page.notes: Page 49 of Respublica Carthaginiensium. The text is set in roman type. Words I could not check letter by letter: "cercurus" (may be a printed variant), "classus" (the scan is faint), and the catchword "thag", which sits at the right edge and is cut off, so it is marked [?]. The "d" at the foot is the gathering signature. The "sc" in "in quem usum, sc nescire" is printed that way. The printed "s" forms are written as plain s, and "fimulque", "verfantes" and "nifi" have been corrected to simulque, versantes and nisi per the u/v and long-s rules. The empty foot paragraph should be removed if no footnote is printed.
